page_title: CLE 2-4 MON | Clermont v Monaco 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' The total number of attempts is 8:12.
90+7' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Eliot Matazo (Monaco) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+4' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
90+3' Substitution. Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) replaces Caio Henrique.
90+2' 2 - 4 Goal! Eliot Matazo puts the ball across the area and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:4.
90+1' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Wissam Ben Yedder will be replaced by Myron Boadu (Monaco).
90+1' Caio Henrique (Monaco) picks up an injury.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Bilal Boutobba (Clermont) coming on for Muhammed Cham.
87' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Clermont was in an offside position.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aleksandr Golovin trots off the pitch and is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
86' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) replacing Takumi Minamino.
82' A cross from a corner kick by Clermont is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
81' Here comes a substitution. Mehdi Zeffane is given a rest as he is replaced by Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont).
80' Substitution. Maxime Gonalons makes way for Yohan Magnin (Clermont).
76' Pascal Gastien prepares a substitution. Jim Allevinah is replaced by Jeremie Bela (Clermont).
76' It's time for a substitution. Komnen Andric (Clermont) comes on in place of Grejohn Kyei.
75' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Clermont.
70' 2 - 3 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) takes a short pass from Vanderson in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 2:3.
69' 6:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
65' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
62' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
60' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
56' Clermont have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

53' 2 - 2 GOAL! A great pass finds Muhammed Cham (Clermont) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 2:2.
52' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francois Letexier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
48' The ball is out of play. Clermont will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' A rebound lands at the feet of Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont), whose promising strike from long range smashes against left post! What an opportunity that was!
47' The ball goes out for a corner. Clermont can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Half-time substitution. Mohamed Camara (Monaco) will not participate anymore and Eliot Matazo is coming on.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+11' The match has reached half-time.
45+10' The Clermont players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45+6' Philipp Kohn leaps to intercept the corner kick from Muhammed Cham (Clermont).
45+6' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+6' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+4' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45+4' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45+3' Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for an infringement.
45' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 1 - 2 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the right side of the net.
43' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
42' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
39' Total attempts – 5:6.
35' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

35' That didn't go as planned! Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Philipp Kohn, who easily kept it out.

33' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Mory Diaw, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
33' Vanderson (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
31' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
29' Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
26' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Takumi Minamino sprays a pass out to Vanderson (Monaco), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
25' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) is able to continue to play.
23' Looks like Alidu Seidu (Clermont) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

18' Andy Pelmard (Clermont) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Philipp Kohn allowed him to make a comfortable save.
16' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
15' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
13' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
13' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes a direct free kick.
12' A player from Clermont commits a rough challenge. Francois Letexier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
11' OFF THE POST! Good play from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post!
9' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
7' 1 - 0 Muhammed Cham takes the corner and Mateusz Wieteska (Clermont) rises highest near the penalty spot to plant a brilliant header into the middle of the net. The score is 1:0.
7' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) prepares to take a corner kick.
7' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Clermont earn a corner.
6' Vanderson (Monaco) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
4' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Neto Borges (Clermont) but poses no threat.
3' Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francois Letexier.
